nametag_health.config.title: Nametag Health
nametag_health.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Turn off to leave every nametag untouched.
nametag_health.option.show_on_players.to: Add the indicator to other players' nametags.
nametag_health.option.show_on_mobs.toolt: Also add it to mobs that already show a nametag, which in practice means named ones.
nametag_health.option.hide_when_full.too: Hide the indicator at full health, so tags stay clean until a fight starts. A recent heal still shows briefly.
nametag_health.option.max_distance.toolt: Beyond this distance the nametag is drawn as normal, with no indicator.
nametag_health.option.toggled_on.tooltip: The state flipped by the toggle keybind. Bind a key in Controls to switch it in game.
nametag_health.option.reveal_mode.toolti: Which situations show indicators at all, from always on to only while aiming at something.
nametag_health.option.reveal_items.toolt: Item ids that count as held for the "Holding listed item" reveal mode. The namespace is optional, so "mace" works as well as "minecraft:mace".
nametag_health.option.require_line_of_si: Hide the indicator when blocks sit between you and the entity, even though vanilla draws the nametag through walls.
nametag_health.option.respect_hud_hidden: Disappear along with the rest of the interface when F1 is pressed, which keeps screenshots clean.
nametag_health.option.hide_for_invisible: Do not decorate entities under an invisibility effect.
nametag_health.option.team_filter.toolti: Restrict indicators by scoreboard team, so you can watch only allies or only opponents.
nametag_health.option.entity_filter_mode: Whether the entity list below is ignored, used as an allow list, or used as a deny list.
nametag_health.option.entity_filter.tool: Entity ids for the filter above, such as "creeper" or "minecraft:villager".
nametag_health.option.min_max_health.too: Ignore entities with less total health than this. Useful for skipping chickens and bats.
nametag_health.option.max_max_health.too: Ignore entities with more total health than this. Useful for leaving bosses to their own health bar.
nametag_health.option.placement.tooltip: Put the indicator after the name, before it, or use it instead of the name entirely.
nametag_health.option.format_template.to: Lay the indicator out yourself. Leave empty to use the style and toggles below. Tokens: {sym} {hp} {max} {frac} {pct} {bar} {abs} {armor} {fx} {ping} {delta}. Any word whose tokens are all absent is dropped, so spacing never breaks.
nametag_health.option.style.tooltip: How the health value is written when no template is set.
nametag_health.option.decimals.tooltip: 0 rounds to whole hearts. 1 or 2 show partial health.
nametag_health.option.symbol.tooltip: Glyph for the {sym} token. Leave empty to drop it.
nametag_health.option.wrap_in_brackets.t: Surround the whole indicator with grey square brackets.
nametag_health.option.show_absorption.to: Append a gold +n for golden hearts. Ignored when a template is set, where you place {abs} yourself.
nametag_health.option.show_armor.tooltip: Append the entity's armour points, so you can tell a naked player from a kitted one.
nametag_health.option.armor_symbol.toolt: Glyph drawn before the armour value.
nametag_health.option.show_effects.toolt: Mark entities that are under a potion effect. A client can only see the swirl particles the server sends, so this reports how many effects are active, not which ones — naming them is impossible without a server-side mod.
nametag_health.option.effect_style.toolt: One marker per effect, or a single marker with a count.
Caps how many markers appear in the dots style.
nametag_health.option.show_delta.tooltip: Briefly show how much health just changed, as -4 or +2. Rapid hits accumulate into one running total.
How long a recent change stays on screen.
nametag_health.option.show_ping.tooltip: Append a player's connection latency, coloured green through red.
nametag_health.option.abbreviate_large_n: Write 1200 as 1.2k, which keeps high-health modded bosses from stretching the nametag.
nametag_health.option.abbreviate_above.t: Health values at or above this get abbreviated.
nametag_health.option.bar_segments.toolt: Number of segments in the bar style.
nametag_health.option.bar_filled.tooltip: Character used for remaining health in the bar style.
nametag_health.option.bar_empty.tooltip: Character used for missing health in the bar style.
nametag_health.option.color_mode.tooltip: Blend smoothly through the palette, step between its three colours, or ignore health and use one fixed colour.
nametag_health.option.palette.tooltip: The three colours health runs through. Colour-blind avoids the red and green pairing; monochrome reads by brightness alone.
nametag_health.option.high_threshold.too: At or above this share of health the indicator is fully the palette's healthy colour. This also sets where the gradient stops blending.
nametag_health.option.low_threshold.tool: At or below this share of health the indicator is fully the palette's critical colour. Widening the gap to the healthy threshold makes the fade gentler.
nametag_health.option.static_color.toolt: Used when colour mode is set to fixed.
Keep the number white and colour just the symbol or bar.
nametag_health.option.low_health_pulse.t: Fade the colour in and out once health drops below the threshold, to catch your eye mid-fight.
nametag_health.option.pulse_threshold.to: Health share at which pulsing starts.
nametag_health.option.pulse_speed.toolti: Time for one full fade out and back in. Lower is more urgent.
nametag_health.option.smoothing_millis.t: Time the shown health takes to slide a full bar's worth toward the real value. 0 snaps instantly. Animating costs a little more per frame.
nametag_health.option.update_interval_mi: How often the indicator text is rebuilt. Raise it to spend less time per frame; animations ignore it.
nametag_health.option.effect_symbol.tool: Glyph used for the effect marker.
nametag_health.option.effect_color.toolt: Colour of the effect markers. Effects are not identifiable client-side, so they all share one colour.
nametag_health.option.show_armor_durabil: Show the remaining durability of whichever armour piece is closest to breaking. Ranked by fraction, so a nearly spent helmet outranks a chestplate that merely has more total durability.
nametag_health.option.armor_durability_s: Percentage left, hits remaining before it breaks, or remaining out of total.
Mark which piece the number belongs to, giving "H 34" for a helmet. Coloured with the value, so the pair turns red together.
nametag_health.option.armor_durability_l: Text placed before the durability value. Free-form — a word, a glyph, or nothing at all. Empty by default, since the slot letter already says what the number refers to.
nametag_health.option.slot_label_head.to: Marker for the head slot. Defaults to "H"; set any text or glyph, or leave it empty.
nametag_health.option.slot_label_chest.t: Marker for the chest slot. Defaults to "C"; set any text or glyph, or leave it empty.
nametag_health.option.slot_label_legs.to: Marker for the legs slot. Defaults to "L"; set any text or glyph, or leave it empty.
nametag_health.option.slot_label_feet.to: Marker for the feet slot. Defaults to "B"; set any text or glyph, or leave it empty.
